sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - Marketplace FBA Store

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Vanuatu and the Government of the People's Republic of China on the Promotion and Protection of Investments (signed 2001, in force 2004)
Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Vanuatu and the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland for the Promotion and Protection of Investments (1991)
Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Vanuatu and the Government of the French Republic on the Reciprocal Encouragement and Protection of Investments (1987)
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations, signed 2017, in force for Vanuatu 2020; covers trade in goods, services and digital trade channels relevant to cross-border e-commerce)
No comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTAA) network is in force for Vanuatu; reliance is placed on the domestic tax-exempt status granted to International Companies.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2020 (Vanuatu), as amended; International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended (mandatory beneficial ownership register for International Companies); Financial Intelligence Unit (Vanuatu) directives and guidance notes issued under the AML/CFT Act; VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook applicable to licensed registered agents and financial institutions; Hague Apostille Convention (1961), acceded to by Vanuatu effective 30 September 1991.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the Certificate of Incorporation of the International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Corporate Registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the Supreme Court of Vanuatu, Port Vila

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and apostilled extract of the Register of Directors, Members, and Beneficial Owners
Apostilled certified copy of passport of each director, shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin of the individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization for non-Hague Convention jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Apostilled proof of residential address (bank statement or utility bill issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution or utility provider in the applicant's country of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against the United Nations Consolidated Security Council Sanctions List, the OFAC SDN List, the UK HMT Sanctions List, and domestic designations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2020 (sections 39-43). Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons (foreign and domestic PEPs), their family members and close associates, requiring senior management approval of the registered agent and verified source of wealth and source of funds. Continuous monitoring applies where the entity operates in payment corridors involving FATF-listed high-risk jurisdictions; Vanuatu has been subject to FATF increased monitoring in recent years, and correspondent banks may apply enhanced CDD.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry - Name Availability Search and Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Latin script. English, French, and Bislama names are permissible; names originating in non-Latin scripts require certified transliteration into Latin characters. An International Company must end with one of the statutory suffixes: 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Societe Anonyme', or 'SA'. The VFSC Registry applies normalization rules for numerals, special characters, and diacritics, and will refuse names identical or confusingly similar to names already registered, reserved, or appearing on the VFSC index.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, or Trust / Trustee (requires prior approval of the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu or the relevant licensing authority)
Insurance, Assurance, or Reinsurance (requires consent of the Vanuatu Insurance Regulator)
Finance or Financial Services (sensitive; triggers regulatory license assessment)
Group or Holdings (sensitive; requires disclosure of underlying group structure)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are valid for 30 days; no automatic extension is available, and the applicant must file a fresh name reservation application after expiry, subject to the same priority rules. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative objection with the VFSC Registry within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds of objection and, where curable, an amended name variant; the Registry must respond within 10 business days. If the administrative objection is denied, the applicant may apply for judicial review under the inherent supervisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 30 days of the final Registry decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible at the registered-agent level. An International Company must at all times maintain a registered office in Vanuatu, which may lawfully be the premises of its VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila. No physical business premises or physical staffing in Vanuatu is required for an Amazon FBA marketplace retail operation. Virtual office administrative services are accepted, provided the licensed registered agent's physical address is used for statutory filings, service of process, and official correspondence. Banking and payment-rail providers (for example Amazon Pay, Stripe, Airwallex) do not require physical presence in Vanuatu, but their due-diligence questionnaires will require a substance declaration explaining the cross-border e-commerce model and third-party fulfillment (FBA) arrangements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: quantified probability of approximately 8-10% for an unannounced on-site inspection within the first three years for a low-risk, non-licensed e-commerce International Company. Probability increases to approximately 25-40% if the entity is flagged for KYC documentation anomalies, PEP involvement, unusual payment patterns, or transactions with FATF high-risk jurisdictions. The VFSC retains statutory inspection powers under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2020.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official VFSC fee schedule; non-refundable processing charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] statutory fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service - first annual retainer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for VFSC-licensed registered agents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; statutory obligations under the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2020

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per individual screened against UN, OFAC, HMT, and domestic lists

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public and the Supreme Court of Vanuatu (Apostille Section)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961; government apostille tariff plus notarial fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified document courier and international handling (express delivery of original legalized documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing international courier rate from Vanuatu to the applicant's jurisdiction

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap 222 (Vanuatu), particularly sections 4-12 (Registration), 14-16 (Memorandum and Articles), 20 (Registered Office), 31 (Directors), and 36 (Share Capital)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation and Notice of Registered Agent/Office (Form IC-01), resulting in Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement under the International Companies Act; issued share capital may be USD 1. No escrow or capital deposit account is required for an International Company engaged in general online retailing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The Company adopts its instrument of incorporation as filed with the Registrar and subscribes to one issued share at a par value of USD 1 per share; (2) the registered office in Port Vila is approved and the registered agent is appointed; (3) the first directors accept office, with authority to open bank and payment-processor accounts, execute business agreements, and engage counsel; (4) the company secretary is appointed; and (5) the board delegates to the managing director day-to-day administration for online marketplace operations. Any director is authorized to certify copies and effect all filings required under the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – online name search and reservation portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an online name availability search against the VFSC register; submit a name reservation request with the proposed name, confirm no similarity to existing protected names, and pay the name reservation fee. Receive a name reservation certificate valid for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Feasibility statement confirming no prohibited name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or undesirability, amend the proposed name by adding a distinguishing element or acronym and resubmit online; objection rights under Cap 222 section 6 may be exercised.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares instrument of incorporation (memorandum and articles), share register, consent of directors, and registered office consent. Signatures are notarized before a Vanuatu Notary Public or certified by the registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries any clause of the memorandum, the registered agent amends the clause and circulates a supplementary written resolution for shareholder/director approval without formal meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – filings window or encrypted electronic filing system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-01, certified copies of the instrument of incorporation, statutory declarations, and proof of name reservation. Pay the statutory filing fee and await review and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of instrument of incorporation
Declaration of compliance by registered agent
Payment receipt of state filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or rejected, the registered agent files a cure notice correcting missing signatures or attachments within 14 days; re-filing fee is waived for the same application file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon completion of review, the Registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation and returns stamped copies of the constitutional documents. Review the certificate for exact company name, number, and date.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains clerical errors, request re-issuance under the VFSC correction procedure within 10 business days with an affidavit of typographical error.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue Share Certificates and Open Corporate Banking
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company board and licensed banking institutions in Vanuatu (e.g., ANZ, BSP, or licensed global banking providers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: At a board meeting, issue share certificates, adopt banking resolutions, and execute account opening forms. For non-resident directors, complete Know-Your-Customer, source of wealth declarations, and payment-processor due diligence.
required_dossiers: Board resolution on share issuance and banking
Director identification and proof of address
Reference letter from a bank or accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If banking due diligence requests additional evidence, provide audited source of funds plus an Amazon FBA seller registry screenshot; request escrow-account waiver confirmation from the bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register for Tax Exemption and Annual Compliance Calendar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs with VFSC oversight
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a notification of exemption under the International Companies Act confirming no Vanuatu tax applies on offshore business; establish annual compliance calendar for renewal of registered agent, annual license fee payment, and filing of any change of directors or registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the exemption notification is challenged, provide evidence of non-resident ownership and absence of local-source income; apply for a written no-tax ruling from Vanuatu Revenue and Customs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry and VFSC Licensing Division (not applicable to pure online resale)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business/Trade License (optional for physical retail only; not required for export-oriented online marketplace sales)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Registration not required for pure e-commerce retail without local manufacturing, packaging lines, or physical waste generation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater discharge or VOC emissions are generated from virtual-office operations; if a third-party fulfillment center is used offshore, the operator's environmental permits govern. Any local repackaging would require compliance with waste segregation standards under VEPA regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and structural load inspections are not required for a virtual registered-office presence; if the company leases a physical office for administrative staff, compliance with Vanuatu National Building Code (structural integrity, fire exit, and occupational health clearance) becomes mandatory, issued by the Vanuatu Public Works Department and Fire Service.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management. Official portal: https://www.vrca.gov.vu/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu levies no income tax or capital gains tax on domestic or foreign entities, so no general corporate TIN procurement exists. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is exempt from all taxes and duties and does not require a tax registration number. Only an IC that makes taxable supplies within Vanuatu exceeding the VAT threshold must register for VAT and obtain a VAT identification number through VRCA Form VAT-001, accompanied by certificate of incorporation, directors'/shareholders' register, business licence, and bank account details. Foreign entities without a physical presence in Vanuatu may not obtain a TIN unless they become VAT-registered or are statutorily required to withhold any colourable levy.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box regime, no CFC rules, no hybrid mismatch elections, and no income tax law to elect pass-through treatment. An IC may voluntarily waive its exempt international status by electing to be registered as an ordinary local company under the Companies Act [Cap. 191], thereby forfeiting the tax exemption and becoming subject to VAT and ordinary business licensing rules. No other tax classification elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) / Goods and Services Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover (VT 5 million per consecutive 12-month period)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, public API integration, or digital stamping regime is implemented in Vanuatu. VRCA permits paper and electronic tax invoices. Registered VAT suppliers must issue a valid VAT invoice showing supplier VAT number, invoice date, description, quantity, and tax amount, but there is no government-approved clearance platform or prior validation requirement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and international services are zero-rated under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998 (s.10) where the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu or the services are supplied to a non-resident and are not connected with land or movable property in Vanuatu. For an Amazon FBA general retail operation, zero-rating is claimable only if the goods are supplied to non-resident consumers and are exported from Vanuatu customs territory; goods held or fulfilled outside Vanuatu do not enter the Vanuatu VAT chain and therefore are outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT rather than subject to zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Transport Document (Airway Bill or Sea Waybill)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA may conduct export VAT refund audits and request full evidentiary documentation. A false zero-rating claim or fraudulent export evidence may result in refund denial, retrospective clawback of input VAT credits, penalty of 100% of the tax evaded or sought to be evaded, negligence penalties up to 50%, monthly interest of 1% on unpaid tax, deregistration from the VAT register, and criminal liability for company directors. Under the International Companies Act, fraudulent activity may additionally lead to striking-off and disqualification of the IC.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - central bank and administrator of exchange control delegated under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 95]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) regulates International Companies and registered agents. VUV (Vanuatu Vatu, ISO 4217: VUV) is pegged to the IMF Special Drawing Rights (SDR) basket effective 1 August 2011.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations; VUV is freely convertible for current account transactions. Capital account operations of resident persons require RBV exchange control approval under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 95], but International Companies (ICs) are statutorily exempt from exchange control as non-resident entities and may freely hold, convert, and remit foreign currency. Profit remittance for a VU IC is unrestricted: dividends, liquidation proceeds, and shareholder loans are repatriable without VUV conversion imposts and are subject to zero withholding tax under the current zero-income-tax regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender obligation or mandatory conversion ratio applies to a non-resident VU International Company; Amazon FBA gross receipts in USD may be retained, swept, or converted at will in its foreign-currency operational accounts. Resident domestic exporters are required to receive export proceeds through an authorized dealer within 180 days of shipment and offer such receipts for conversion into VUV unless RBV approval to retain foreign currency is granted. The VU IC's exempt status removes all statutory conversion and repatriation timelines at the entity level.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD/VUV) and Operational USD Current Account; Amazon settlement receiving account
Operational Multi-Currency Account (USD/AUD/EUR/VUV) for working capital and FX hedging
Operational VUV account for domestic settlement; limited USD clearing capacity

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited (legacy institutional treasury segment; retail/commercial portfolio transferred to BSP in 2023)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Corporate treasury and FX forward account for institutional-grade liquidity (legacy relationship)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility. Payoneer, WorldFirst, and Airwallex generally accept Vanuatu International Companies with a fully documented Amazon Seller Central profile and VFSC beneficial-ownership filing; onboarding terms, however, are discretionary and subject to enhanced internal AML review because of Vanuatu's prior FATF grey-listing (removed 28 June 2024). Legal constraint: no local Vanuatu e-money license is triggered for a foreign EMI servicing a non-resident IC provided there is no local solicitation; conversely, a foreign EMI may decline VU risk and require a U.S./HK/SG auxiliary entity. Stripe shows Low direct viability for a VU IC and should be routed through a supported auxiliary entity. Amazon Pay direct settlement is not available in VUV; all merchant payouts must land in a USD-denominated account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Incorporation with a VFSC-registered agent is fully remote; no Companies Office appearance is required. For banking, BSP and NBV typically mandate at least one director or authorized signatory to attend an in-person or video-instructed KYC interview (Port Vila branch or an approved remote notarization route). BRED Bank accepts full remote onboarding with certified true copies, apostilled corporate documents, and an electronic AML questionnaire. A resident professional director with signatory authority is recommended to accelerate account activation and reduce the compliance burden.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore International Company with nominee shareholders - perceived jurisdictional arbitrage
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; stamped certificate of incorporation for the IC; VFSC beneficial-ownership register filing receipt (International Companies (Amendment) Act 2020); registered agent attestation; tax exemption certificate; sworn source-of-funds affidavits of the ultimate beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Residual reputational flag from Vanuatu's FATF grey-listing (2022-2024)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official FATF statement recording removal from grey-list (28 June 2024); VFSC compliance attestation; entity-level AML/CFT policy statement; 12 months of Amazon settlement statements evidencing genuine marketplace sales and no sanctions nexus.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained initial equity injection or mismatch between declared Amazon turnover and bank inflows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 3 months of shareholder bank statements showing the source of capital; notarized declaration of fund origin; Amazon Seller Central payout ledger; supplier pro-forma invoices; logistics and customs export documentation; reconciliation of working-capital flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership mismatch or nominee/anonymous holding structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full BO disclosure per VFSC circular; notarized passport copies of all natural persons; signed shareholder registry; non-resident status proof; written confirmation from the registered agent that no bearer shares are issued.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All equity contributions and shareholder loans must be routed by SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire/CHIPS for USD originating in the United States) to the IC's named USD account at BSP or BRED. Remittance information in field 70/72 must state 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION - INTERNATIONAL COMPANY [LEGAL NAME] - VFSC FILE NUMBER' together with the beneficial owner's reference and the approved purpose code for capital injection (e.g., 'G2 - Equity Capital' or the correspondent bank's equivalent). Include the IC's Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC file number to ease correspondent filtering. No VUV-specific clearing rail exists; incoming USD is credited via the correspondent gateway (for example Bank of New York Mellon or Citi) with T+1/T+2 value dating. Supplier funding from Chinese trading partners must not be executed through personal Alipay or cash rails; disburse exclusively from the operational USD account via compliant TT.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Amazon Global Selling settlements are remitted in USD to the IC's designated USD receiving account, either by direct wire from Amazon treasury or via Hyperwallet/Payoneer virtual USD account; weekly payout frequency is recommended with automatic reconciliation against Seller Central reports. Supplier payments for FBA inventory use SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers with purpose code '110 - Commercial Trade Payment' or equivalent, with memo referencing the commercial invoice number. For high-value manufacturer orders, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (LC at sight) may be issued via BSP or an offshore confirming bank, with documents against payment clearing through the LC advising bank. Intragroup management fees and profit distributions use MT103 with intercompany service agreement references; no exchange-control approval is required for the non-resident IC.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards (NDF) traded offshore with non-resident licensed counterparties - settlement in USD, required because VUV is non-deliverable outside Vanuatu despite the SDR peg
Deliverable VUV spot and short-tenor forward contracts with RBV-licensed authorized dealers (BSP, BRED) executed under the non-resident IC exemption from the Exchange Control Act [Cap 95]
Cross-currency swaps between USD and AUD/EUR with top-tier counterparties to hedge non-USD supplier and logistics cost centers
Zero-cost FX collars and vanilla options on AUD/USD and EUR/USD crosses for semi-annual projected Amazon settlement exposure; VUV/USD option liquidity is negligible and should be covered via NDF
Natural hedge via multi-currency liquidity pool (USD 60% / AUD 20% / EUR 20%) with periodic rebalancing to reduce derivative notional

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual return and annual government renewal fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of registration date; annual return and renewal fee must be submitted on or before the registration anniversary each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty accrues per month or part month at approximately USD 50; continued non-payment may lead to administrative strike-off and dissolution of the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered agent and registered office annual confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent (maintained on record for VFSC inspection)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary date; agent confirmation must be finalized at least 14 days before the annual return filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent or registered office in Vanuatu is a statutory contravention that can trigger deregistration proceedings and personal liability on the company's officers

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard Vanuatu International Company; a VFSC-licensed financial institution or an IC undertaking a relevant activity under the Economic Substance (Amendment) Act may be required to keep audited accounting records. Cross-border retail e-commerce conducted via Amazon FBA does not trigger a compulsory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting framework is prescribed for International Companies; where financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS is the generally accepted reference standard. No statutory filing of financial statements with VFSC is required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual return confirms directors, members and share capital as at the anniversary date. Any share transfers must be recorded in the register of members before the registered agent certifies the annual return. There is no separate UBO declaration for a non-regulated Vanuatu International Company; beneficial ownership information is held by the registered agent and must be available for VFSC or Financial Intelligence Unit inspection upon written request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: None mandated; voluntary certified audit typically USD 1,500 - USD 4,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil; Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on International Companies under section 3 of the International Companies Act, Cap. 222)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective tax rate. An International Company (IC) is statutorily exempted from all taxes, duties, levies and imposts on its assets, property, capital, income, profits and operations, including income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, interest and royalty withholding tax, and stamp duty. No tax holiday application or advance ruling is required; the exemption is automatic and perpetual and extends to the IC's shareholders in respect of distributions. Export transactions of the Amazon FBA model are also zero-rated for Vanuatu VAT purposes, producing no domestic consumption tax leakage.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax return. The compulsory annual compliance instruments are (a) the VFSC International Company Annual Renewal Declaration (Form IC-AR / Agent Annual Return) filed by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry agent portal, and (b) where a relevant activity is carried on, the Economic Substance Return (ESR Form 1) submitted to the VFSC under the Companies and Financial Institutions (Economic Substance) Act 2019.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The IC annual renewal declaration and government fee are due on the anniversary date of incorporation, with a 30-day grace period before late surcharges accrue. The Economic Substance Return, when applicable, must be filed within 12 months of the end of the financial year (accounting reference date), failing which monthly non-compliance penalties commence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and VFSC registration number exactly as stated on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Name may use Latin script only; verify spelling against the VFSC register; non-resident beneficial owners need not appear on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date of incorporation and annual fee anniversary date; basis for calculating the renewal deadline and fee bracket.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No tax identification number or local fiscal address is required for non-resident principals; the anniversary date is fixed at registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, including number of shares and par value; determines the VFSC annual fee tier and any late penalty calculation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may hold any share class; no minimum capital is imposed and no capital duty applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent certification block: the licensed Vanuatu registered agent confirms the IC maintains a registered office and agent in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent acts as statutory addressee for all non-resident principals, including service of process from foreign tax and customs authorities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of directors: full legal names, aliases, residential addresses, nationality, and identification document numbers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Overseas residential addresses are acceptable; certified copies of passports and proof of address must be retained by the agent under AML rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners (confidential BO register maintained by the registered agent and accessible to the VFSC, not publicly filed).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For corporate shareholders, the chain of ownership must be traced to natural persons; foreign tax residence of owners is declared for information purposes only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compliance honesty declaration: confirmation that the IC has not engaged in prohibited domestic trading in Vanuatu, does not hold land in Vanuatu, and is not conducting activity contrary to the IC Act or public policy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A pure Amazon FBA marketplace reseller supplying customers outside Vanuatu satisfies the prohibited-activity test; domestic retail to Vanuatu customers would breach the IC licence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance status election: declaration whether the IC is a passive holding vehicle or carries on a relevant activity (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centre, intellectual property, holding company).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC operating an Amazon FBA trading platform must review the 'distribution and service centre' category; falsely electing passive status is a criminal misdeclaration by the directors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government fee payment and VFSC receipt reference; the agent files the declaration conditioned on cleared payment of the renewal fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment is ordinarily effected by non-resident principals via SWIFT to the agent as a disbursement; no Vatu bank account in Vanuatu is mandatory.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal fee penalty of 20% of the annual government fee applies if payment is not completed within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation; continued default entitles the VFSC to strike the IC off the register and dissolve it, risking forfeiture of marketplace accounts and receivables. ESR non-compliance attracts a VT 1,000,000 penalty plus VT 100,000 per month of continued contravention; knowingly filing a false substance declaration attracts a criminal fine up to VT 20,000,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (no dividend withholding tax is imposed in Vanuatu on distributions paid by an International Company to residents or non-residents; dividends may flow to foreign Amazon FBA principals free of any Vanuatu source tax).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement in force; only limited exchange-of-information instruments exist (e.g., TIEA arrangements with Australia and New Zealand and the OECD principal purpose framework). An IC distributing profits to non-resident shareholders invokes no treaty relief because the domestic statutory rate is already zero. To evidence tax status to foreign revenue authorities and payment processors, a certificate of incorporation and a certificate of good standing may be obtained from the VFSC through the registered agent; a domestic tax residence certificate or treaty relief application procedure does not exist.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for royalty and interest payments by an International Company to non-residents; no deemed-source withholding, no thin capitalisation charge, and no interest capping rules apply. Vanuatu levies no withholding on cross-border payments for Amazon marketplace fees, software licensing, or trade finance interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold and no Local File or Master File regime exists because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax. However, under the Companies and Financial Institutions (Economic Substance) Act 2019, an IC that carries on the relevant activity of a distribution and service centre must maintain contemporaneous records evidencing economic substance in Vanuatu, including local employees, local premises, local board decision-making and local operating expenditure, irrespective of transaction size. There is no minimum VUV threshold for such records; the obligation is triggered by the nature of the activity, not monetary volume.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations apply to every Vanuatu incorporated company, including an International Company, unless the company is tax resident in a foreign jurisdiction appearing on the OECD list of compliant jurisdictions. An Amazon FBA IC that purchases goods from connected foreign suppliers, resells via marketplace platforms to third-party customers, or provides management services to group entities may be classified under the 'distribution and service centre' or 'headquarters' relevant activity and must satisfy all of: (a) at least 50% of directors' meetings held physically in Vanuatu with a quorum present in Vanuatu; (b) adequate qualified employees working in Vanuatu; (c) adequate physical premises available exclusively to the IC; (d) adequate local operating expenditure; and (e) core income-generating activities performed by staff in Vanuatu. A bare mailbox entity directing e-commerce operations from abroad fails the ESR test and faces automatic penalty and enforcement by the VFSC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Avoidance Abroad
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC as a nominee facade to conceal the true beneficial owner of Amazon FBA sales, misrepresent the commercial activity to Amazon and payment processors (Stripe, Airwallex, Amazon Pay), understate VAT, customs duties or income tax in destination markets, or artificially strand profits in Vanuatu without economic substance to avoid foreign taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC deregistration and compulsory winding-up under the International Companies Act; exchange of information with foreign tax authorities under Vanuatu's TIEA and AEOI commitments; freezing and forfeiture of marketplace receivables; monetary penalties imposed by foreign revenue authorities upon recharacterisation of the IC as a sham.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts pierce the corporate veil where the IC is a mere instrumentality; directors and shadow shareholders are civilly liable to restore diverted funds and pay damages; travel bans, director disqualification orders, and asset restraint orders may be issued by the Vanuatu Supreme Court; custodial sentences up to 2 years for fraud and knowingly making false statutory declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a passive-holding ESR election while the IC actually transacts as a cross-border distributor, procurement hub or group service provider without any Vanuatu premises, employees, board meetings or operating expenditure, thereby falsely representing that no relevant activity is performed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate penalty of VT 1,000,000, cumulative monthly penalty of VT 100,000 for continuing contravention, remedial directions compelling substance creation within a fixed period, and ultimate strike-off and dissolution for persistent non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed a false substance declaration are individually liable for the corporate penalties; criminal prosecution may impose fines up to VT 20,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 1 year; foreign principals directing the entity are treated as shadow directors and equally exposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Beneficial Ownership Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to disclose ultimate beneficial owners to the Vanuatu registered agent, providing false identification documents, refusing to file the confidential BO register, or wilfully omitting suspicious transaction reports on Amazon marketplace settlements, Stripe and Airwallex inflows, or high-risk third-country counterparts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enforcement under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019: monetary penalties up to VT 10,000,000, mandatory account freezing orders, agent licence revocation, and referral to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit for criminal investigation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors face criminal liability for money laundering and terrorist financing predicate offences, with custodial terms up to 5 years and personal financial penalties; directors may also be banned from acting as company officers in any VFSC-regulated jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Sham Substance Arrangement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC purely as a parked shell with no physical footprint, no real decision-making, no separate bank account, and no records, using nominee directors to route Amazon FBA revenues through high-risk payment rails while the true operator remains undisclosed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and dissolution by the VFSC without a winding-up process, seizure of residual assets by the Registrar, adverse disclosure to beneficial ownership exchange networks, and disqualification of the registered agent who failed to verify substance and ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors are personally liable for unpaid government fees, agent costs and dissolution expenses; civil restitution orders compel repatriation of corporate assets to creditors; travel restrictions and extradition exposure arise where foreign tax or customs authorities issue criminal charges against the controlling person.
